body:
Refreshed for merge: merged origin/main into the branch (merge commit 862536f73, no rebase, no force).

Hand-resolved files:
- crates/ui/src/state.rs: both sides added a `#[path]` module line (`state_move_by.rs` here, `state_align.rs` on main); kept both.
- crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs: conflicted as a whole file. Took main's version (which already carries the #979 pick box, #1507 hover, gcode_view and viewport_layout changes) and re-applied this PR's five body-drag hunks on top: the press guard (`move_drag::press`), Escape cancel, release routing, motion routing and `update_hover` flag, plus the `move_handles::draw` call. The body-drag branches sit before main's pick-box and orbit branches, so a ball drag wins and the pick box and orbit are unchanged otherwise.

Gate: `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` on the merged head: ui lib unit tests plus the boundary, boundary_picks, feedback, fixtures, gpu_render, machine, models, operations, shell, sinker_setup and theme_files suites, all green (228 s).

Not exercised: pixel snapshots (release lane), the GUI by hand (the PR's own hand check is still owed), other crates' suites.

The PR is still a draft. Ready for a re-check.
